text: Ten fictional nonprofit programme passages, each with eight quote variants for testing a citation checker.

passages.source_passage: Welcome to the Kestrel Valley Mobility Project volunteer training. Over the next 3 days you will learn how to fit wheelchairs, walking frames and hearing aids safely. Since 2021 our teams have assessed 640 people across Lowmere district, and 72% of them received a device within six weeks. Do not adjust a wheelchair cushion without first asking the user how they sit during the day. Remember that many users have never been consulted about their own equipment before. Each volunteer will shadow a senior fitter for two full sessions before working alone. Ramps you build at homes must not exceed a gradient of one in twelve.

variants.paraphrase: Wheelchair cushions should only be changed after the user has explained how they normally sit through the day.

passages.source_passage: This guide is for volunteers mentoring trainees at the Brightwater Skills Centre in Orvane. Each intake has 48 young people aged 16 to 24, split between welding, tailoring and solar installation. Last year 61% of graduates found paid work within three months of finishing. Mentors should meet their trainees every Thursday afternoon for at least forty minutes. You are not expected to find jobs for trainees yourself. Instead, help them prepare a CV and practise interview answers with a partner. Trainees who miss more than five sessions won't receive a certificate, so record attendance carefully.

passages.source_passage: In 2023 the Tamura District Community Health Initiative supported 212 community health workers across fourteen sub-counties. Together they made 38,400 household visits, a rise of 19% on the previous year. Workers referred 1,150 children with danger signs to Kasoli Health Centre, and most arrived within twenty-four hours. Senior nurses supervised the new workers each month at sub-county meetings. Stock-outs of oral rehydration salts were not resolved before September, which limited treatment at home for several months. No health worker left the programme because of unpaid stipends, thanks to the Foundation's timely disbursements. We plan to train a further 40 workers in newborn care during the coming year.

passages.source_passage: Monitoring visit, Halden Ridge Camp, Block C, 14 March 2024. The case management team currently holds 327 open cases, of which 41% involve unaccompanied or separated children. Caseworkers completed follow-up visits for 88 survivors of violence during the quarter. However, the private interview room was not available on 9 of 20 working days because it was used for food registration. Two caseworkers have resigned since January and have not yet been replaced. Referrals to legal aid increased after the camp authority approved a weekly mobile clinic. Files are stored in a locked cabinet, but the electronic database still lacks password protection.

passages.source_passage: This report covers the third payment round of the Sorrel Plains Cash for Food programme, completed on 30 June 2023. A total of 2,450 households received 45 dollars each by mobile transfer. Post-distribution checks with 300 randomly selected recipients found that 87% spent most of the money on staple foods. Market prices for maize did not rise noticeably in the four weeks after payment. In Ketterby ward, eleven households reported that agents charged an unofficial fee to cash out. Women headed 58% of enrolled households, and most said they controlled how the transfer was used. No recipient reported being asked to repay the transfer.

passages.source_passage: This mid-term evaluation of the Harrowgate Family Links service reviewed activity from April 2022 to September 2023. During that period, caseworkers traced the families of 136 separated children, and 97 were reunified after home assessments. Foster carers received an average of six days of training, against a target of ten. The evaluation found that monthly follow-up visits were not completed for a quarter of placements in the northern sub-region. Children interviewed said they felt safe with their foster families, and none reported physical punishment. Tracing was slower where birth records had been lost, sometimes taking more than eight months. Coordination with district social welfare officers has improved, but referral forms are still not shared electronically.

passages.source_passage: In its second year, the Lindqvist Rural Savings Programme grew from 85 to 132 village savings and loan groups in Marrow and Esk counties. Members saved a combined 1.9 million shillings, and 74% of loans were repaid on time. Groups set their own interest rates, usually between five and ten percent per cycle. We did not provide external capital, so all lending came from members' own contributions. Fifteen groups completed their first share-out in December, returning savings with interest to members. Women make up 81% of members and hold most leadership posts. One group in Esk dissolved after a cashbox was stolen, and its members haven't yet rejoined another group.

passages.source_passage: As a facilitator in the Greenhollow Farmer Field School network, you will guide a group of 20 to 25 farmers through one full growing season. Each school meets weekly on a shared demonstration plot of about half an acre. Farmers compare a local practice plot with an improved practice plot, and they record observations every session. Do not lecture; let farmers discover answers through their own experiments. In 2022, schools that kept complete records saw bean yields rise by 35%. Never apply pesticide on the plot unless the group has agreed after an agro-ecosystem analysis. Your coordinator will visit at least three times per season to support you.

passages.source_passage: This guide prepares volunteers for the Sundari Clinic Outreach Project in the hill villages around Pemalgaon. You will accompany the auxiliary nurse midwife on home visits to pregnant women and new mothers. Each volunteer covers roughly 60 households and should visit every newborn within 48 hours of birth. Check that the baby is kept warm and breastfed within the first hour. Do not give medicines or advice on dosage; refer any danger sign to the nurse immediately. In 2023, only 52% of mothers in the area attended four antenatal visits, so encourage early registration. Volunteers are never paid per referral, which protects families from pressure.

passages.source_passage: Monitoring summary for the Ravensmoor District bed net campaign, Phase 2, 4 to 18 November 2024. Distribution teams handed out 41,600 long-lasting insecticidal nets, one for every two people registered. Spot checks in 150 households found nets hanging over sleeping spaces in 79% of cases. In Dunmere sub-district, registration lists were not updated after the floods, so some displaced families missed out. Teams did not run out of stock at any site. Health officers trained community volunteers to demonstrate hanging techniques at every distribution point, and leaflets were printed in two local languages. A follow-up survey is planned for March 2025 to measure continued use.
